title: Yandex Direct Agency in Russia & CIS | RMAA Agency

facts.fact: Google Ads is unavailable for paid promotions in Russia due to sanctions, according to the RMAA Agency page, which positions Yandex.Direct as the alternative.
facts.quote: Due to sanctions, Google Ads is unavailable for paid promotions in Russia, making Yandex.Direct an essential alternative.

facts.fact: The RMAA Agency page states that Yandex connects millions of users throughout CIS countries.
facts.quote: It connects millions of users throughout CIS countries.

facts.fact: Advertising in Yandex.Direct works on a pay-per-click model, where advertisers pay for each click on their ad.
facts.quote: Advertising in Yandex.Direct works on a PPC (Pay-Per-Click) model, where advertisers pay for each click on their ad.

facts.fact: According to the RMAA Agency page, the Yandex Advertising Network (YAN) can display ads on hundreds of thousands of sites, mobile apps, and video platforms.
facts.quote: YAN allows ads to be displayed on hundreds of thousands of sites, mobile apps, and video platforms.

facts.fact: Yandex.Direct allows advertisers to set specific time intervals for displaying ads, such as only during working hours or on weekends.
facts.quote: Yandex.Direct allows setting specific time intervals for displaying ads, for example, showing them only during working hours or on weekends.

facts.fact: The primary Russian legislative act governing advertising is Federal Law No. 38-FZ 'On Advertising', dated March 13, 2006.
facts.quote: The primary legislative act is Federal Law No. 38-FZ "On Advertising" (March 13, 2006)

facts.fact: Since September 1, 2022, all online ads in Russia must be labeled with the word 'Advertisement', an ERID identifier, and information about the advertiser.
facts.quote: All online ads must be labeled with the word "Advertisement," an ERID identifier, and information about the advertiser.

facts.fact: The mandatory online ad labeling requirement applies to contextual, targeted, social media and blog, display, and video ads.
facts.quote: Mandatory labeling applies to all types of online advertising, including contextual, targeted, social media and blog ads, as well as display and video ads.

facts.fact: Violating advertising laws in Russia can lead to civil and administrative liability, including fines and other penalties.
facts.quote: Violating advertising laws leads to liability under civil and administrative law. This may include fines and other penalties.

facts.fact: The RMAA Agency page defines ROI as (Profit - Advertising Costs) divided by Advertising Costs.
The RMAA Agency page defines customer acquisition cost (CAC) as total advertising costs divided by the number of new customers acquired through advertising campaigns.
facts.quote: Customer acquisition cost (CAC) is calculated by dividing the total advertising costs by the number of new customers acquired through advertising campaigns.

facts.fact: Yandex.Wordstat is the tool used to select keywords in Yandex.Direct campaigns.
facts.quote: The Yandex.Wordstat tool is used to select keywords in Yandex.Direct.

facts.fact: Paid advertising on social media is subject to the same requirements as other media, including mandatory labeling.
facts.quote: Paid advertising on social media is subject to the same requirements as other media, including mandatory labeling

facts.fact: Advertisers must register their ads in ERIR.
Advertisers must ensure mandatory ad labeling and comply with all requirements established by advertising laws.
facts.quote: ensure mandatory ad labeling, register ads in ERIR, and comply with all requirements established by advertising laws

facts.fact: Further tightening of advertising transparency requirements, increased control over the use of personal data, and development of mechanisms to ensure advertising-law compliance are expected.
facts.quote: Further tightening of advertising transparency requirements, increased control over the use of personal data, and the development of mechanisms to ensure compliance with advertising laws are expected.
